stories.title: Using a smartwatch at the wheel could land drivers with six points, RAC says
stories.summary: More than a third of drivers who use smartwatches at the wheel may be breaking the law without knowing it, according to new research from the RAC. stories.title: Welsh Government budget allocates £294m across NHS, childcare and schools
stories.summary: Families, patients and young people across Flintshire and north Wales will be affected by a £294m spending plan published by the Welsh Government today, as the Plaid Cymru administration set out its priorities for the first time since taking office. stories.title: North Wales Police officer suspended after being charged with sexual offence
stories.summary: A North Wales Police detective constable has been suspended from duties after being charged with a sexual offence following an incident in the Colwyn Bay area. Detective Constable Harshey-Jones was arrested in connection with an incident on Thursday 11 June. stories.title: A wall collapsed on a man in Padeswood, one of two rescues for NEWSAR on Father’s Day
stories.summary: North East Wales Search and Rescue volunteers responded to two separate incidents on Father’s Day Sunday, including a man injured when a wall collapsed onto him in Padeswood. stories.title: Fire at Widnes waste site declared major incident, smoke visible from Deeside
stories.summary: A large fire at a waste facility in Widnes is producing a heavy smoke plume visible from Deeside, with Cheshire Fire and Rescue Service declaring a major incident 6pm on Monday 22 June.
